facts.fact: Tanel, a Dakar-based digital health insurer operating in Senegal and Cote d'Ivoire, raised a US$2.1 million seed round in 2024, in which French insurer Alan and Ventures Platform are named as backers; TechCabal reports it.

note: Alan's 2026 acquisition of Tanel has an undisclosed price, so no fact; the US$350,000 pre-seed is undated and not recorded.
